title: Pastel Storage
body:
Adds extra storage content to Pastel

* The bottomless bottle, which lets you store a large amount of fluid in a single slot
* The bottomless battery, which lets you store a large amount of FE in one slot.
* The tool container, which lets you store all your tools in a box
* The bottomless shelf, which lets you combine 6 bottomless bundles or bottles into one block
* The bottomless worm, which lets you make multiblock structures to combine bottomless bundles or bottles
* The filter chest, which lets you filter what items get inserted into it
